categories.title: Common Ayats
categories.subtitle: Al-Fatihah, Ayat al-Kursi, end of Al-Baqarah, and the Mu'awwidhat

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿١﴾ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿٢﴾ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿٣﴾ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ﴿٤﴾ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ﴿٥﴾ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ﴿٦﴾ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ ﴿٧﴾
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Al-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin. Ar-Rahmanir-Rahim. Maliki yawmid-din. Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in. Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim. Siratal-ladhina an'amta 'alayhim, ghayril-maghdubi 'alayhim wa lad-dallin.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Master of the Day of Judgement. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path. The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favour, not of those who have earned Your anger, nor of those who have gone astray.
items.note: The Prophet ﷺ confirmed Al-Fatihah as ruqyah (Sahih al-Bukhari 5749). Recite and blow lightly over the affected area or water.

items.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa, Al-Hayyul-Qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi'idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'im-min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim.
items.translation: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
items.note: Whoever recites it after each obligatory prayer is protected (An-Nasa'i). The greatest ayah of the Qur'an (Sahih Muslim 810).

items.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ﴿٢٨٥﴾ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ﴿٢٨٦﴾
items.transliteration: Amanar-Rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal-mu'minun. Kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, la nufarriqu bayna ahadim-mir-rusulih. Wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na, ghufranaka Rabbana wa ilaykal-masir. La yukalliful-lahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat. Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na. Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih. Wa'fu 'anna, waghfir lana, warhamna. Anta Mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
items.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, saying: We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say: We hear and we obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord; to You is the final destination. Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear. It will have what it has earned, and against it is what it has incurred. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or err. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us, and forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our Protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
items.note: Whoever recites these two ayats at night, they suffice him (Sahih al-Bukhari 5009, Sahih Muslim 807).

items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
items.transliteration: Qul Huwal-lahu Ahad. Allahus-Samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad.
items.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. And there is none comparable to Him.
items.note: Recite with Al-Falaq and An-Nas three times morning and evening; it suffices against everything (Abu Dawud 5082, Tirmidhi 3575).

items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
items.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
items.note: One of the two Mu'awwidhat revealed for protection. Verse 4 is specifically relevant against magic worked with knots.

items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
items.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers into the breasts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.
items.note: The Prophet ﷺ would recite the Mu'awwidhat into his palms and wipe over his body every night (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).

categories.title: Ayats Against Sihr (Magic)
categories.subtitle: The account of Musa and the magicians, and the ayah of Babylon

items.arabic: وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَلَٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِ ۚ وَمَا هُمْ بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا لَمَنِ اشْتَرَاهُ مَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَاقٍ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا بِهِ أَنْفُسَهُمْ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ
items.transliteration: Wattaba'u ma tatlush-shayatinu 'ala mulki Sulayman; wa ma kafara Sulaymanu wa lakinnash-shayatina kafaru, yu'allimunan-nasas-sihra wa ma unzila 'alal-malakayni bi-Babila Haruta wa Marut. Wa ma yu'allimani min ahadin hatta yaqula: innama nahnu fitnatun fa la takfur. Fayata'allamuna minhuma ma yufarriquna bihi baynal-mar'i wa zawjih. Wa ma hum bidarrina bihi min ahadin illa bi'idhnillah. Wa yata'allamuna ma yadurruhum wa la yanfa'uhum. Wa laqad 'alimu lamanishtarahu ma lahu fil-akhirati min khalaq. Wa labi'sa ma sharaw bihi anfusahum, law kanu ya'lamun.
items.translation: And they followed what the devils recited during the kingdom of Solomon. Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. But they do not teach anyone until they say: We are only a trial, so do not disbelieve. And yet they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they cannot harm anyone thereby except by Allah's permission. And they learn what harms them and does not benefit them. And they certainly knew that whoever purchased it would have no share in the Hereafter. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew.
items.note: The definitive ayah establishing that magic is disbelief and harm only occurs by Allah's permission.

items.arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ ﴿١١٧﴾ فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ ﴿١١٨﴾ فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانْقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ ﴿١١٩﴾ وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ ﴿١٢٠﴾ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿١٢١﴾ رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ ﴿١٢٢﴾
items.transliteration: Wa awhayna ila Musa an alqi 'asak, fa'idha hiya talqafu ma ya'fikun. Fawaqa'al-haqqu wa batala ma kanu ya'malun. Faghulibu hunalika wanqalabu saghirin. Wa ulqiyas-saharatu sajidin. Qalu amanna bi Rabbil-'alamin, Rabbi Musa wa Harun.
items.translation: And We inspired Moses: Throw your staff — and at once it devoured what they were falsifying. So the truth was established, and what they were doing was made vain. And they were overcome there and returned debased. And the magicians fell down in prostration, saying: We believe in the Lord of the worlds, the Lord of Moses and Aaron.
items.note: Ayah 7:117-118 are among the most recited verses for undoing magic: the truth falls and the false work is nullified.

items.arabic: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ائْتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ ﴿٧٩﴾ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسَىٰ أَلْقُوا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ ﴿٨٠﴾ فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُمْ بِهِ السِّحْرُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ ﴿٨١﴾ وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ ﴿٨٢﴾
items.transliteration: Wa qala Fir'awnu'tuni bikulli sahirin 'alim. Falamma ja'as-saharatu qala lahum Musa alqu ma antum mulqun. Falamma alqaw qala Musa: ma ji'tum bihis-sihr, innal-laha sayubtiluh, innal-laha la yuslihu 'amalal-mufsidin. Wa yuhiqqu-lahul-haqqa bikalimatihi wa law karihal-mujrimun.
items.translation: And Pharaoh said: Bring me every learned magician. When the magicians came, Moses said to them: Throw down whatever you will throw. And when they threw, Moses said: What you have brought is magic. Indeed, Allah will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allah does not set right the work of corrupters. And Allah establishes the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it.
items.note: Ayah 10:81 — 'inna Allaha sayubtiluh' (Allah will nullify it) — is central to ruqyah for sihr.

items.arabic: قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِمَّا أَنْ تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ نَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ ﴿٦٥﴾ قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ ﴿٦٦﴾ فَأَوْجَسَ فِي نَفْسِهِ خِيفَةً مُوسَىٰ ﴿٦٧﴾ قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْأَعْلَىٰ ﴿٦٨﴾ وَأَلْقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوا ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ ﴿٦٩﴾ فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَارُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ ﴿٧٠﴾
items.transliteration: Qalu ya Musa imma an tulqiya wa imma an nakuna awwala man alqa. Qala bal alqu; fa'idha hibaluhum wa 'isiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tas'a. Fa awjasa fi nafsihi khifata Musa. Qulna la takhaf innaka antal-a'la. Wa alqi ma fi yaminika talqaf ma sana'u; innama sana'u kaydu sahir, wa la yuflihus-sahiru haythu ata. Fa ulqiyas-saharatu sujjadan qalu amanna bi Rabbi Haruna wa Musa.
items.translation: They said: O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the first to throw. He said: Rather, you throw. And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him, by their magic, to be slithering. And Moses sensed fear within himself. We said: Fear not! Indeed, it is you who are superior. And throw what is in your right hand; it will devour what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he comes. So the magicians fell down prostrate and said: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.
items.note: Ayah 20:69 — 'wa la yuflihus-sahiru haythu ata' (the magician will never succeed, wherever he comes from) — a key declaration when reciting over sihr.

categories.title: Hasad & 'Ayn (Envy / Evil Eye)
categories.subtitle: Verses and du'as against envy and the evil eye

items.arabic: وَإِنْ يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ ﴿٥١﴾ وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ ﴿٥٢﴾
items.transliteration: Wa in yakadul-ladhina kafaru layuzliqunaka bi'absarihim lamma sami'udh-dhikra wa yaquluna innahu lamajnun. Wa ma huwa illa dhikrul lil-'alamin.
items.translation: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Indeed, he is mad. But it is nothing less than a Reminder to all the worlds.
items.note: Widely recited for the evil eye ('ayn), as it describes being struck by eyes upon hearing the Reminder.

items.arabic: أَمْ يَحْسُدُونَ النَّاسَ عَلَىٰ مَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ ۖ فَقَدْ آتَيْنَا آلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ مُلْكًا عَظِيمًا
items.transliteration: Am yahsudunan-nasa 'ala ma atahumul-lahu min fadlih; faqad atayna Ala Ibrahimal-kitaba wal-hikmata wa ataynahum mulkan 'azima.
items.translation: Or do they envy people for what Allah has given them of His bounty? We did give the family of Abraham the Book and wisdom, and We gave them a great kingdom.
items.note: Directly addresses hasad (envy) of Allah's blessings upon others.

items.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.transliteration: Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
items.translation: And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
items.note: Repeat on its own with presence of heart after reciting the full surah. Pair with the du'a below.

items.reference: Du'a — Refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
items.translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
items.note: Sahih Muslim 2708. Whoever says it three times in the evening, no harm (including from stings/afflictions) will befall him that night (Tirmidhi 3604).

categories.title: Verses of the Unseen (Jinn)
categories.subtitle: Surah Al-Jinn, the watchers of the heaven, and Al-Hashr

items.arabic: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا ﴿١﴾ يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا ﴿٢﴾ وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا ﴿٣﴾ وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا ﴿٤﴾ وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ تَقُولَ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا ﴿٥﴾ وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا ﴿٦﴾
items.transliteration: Qul uhiya ilayya annahustama'a nafarum-minal-jinni faqalu inna sami'na qur'anan 'ajaba. Yahdi ilar-rushdi fa'amanna bih, wa lan nushrika bi Rabbina ahada. Wa annahu ta'ala jaddu Rabbina, mattakhadha sahibataw-wa la walada. Wa annahu kana yaqulu safihuna 'alal-lahi shatata. Wa anna zananna an lan taqulal-insu wal-jinnu 'alal-lahi kadhiba. Wa annahu kana rijalum-minal-insi ya'udhuna birijalim-minal-jinni fazaduhum rahaqa.
items.translation: Say: It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said: Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an. It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate anyone with our Lord. And He, exalted is the Majesty of our Lord, has taken neither a wife nor a son. And our foolish one used to say about Allah an excessive transgression. And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie. And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they only increased them in burden.
items.note: Recite over cases involving the jinn; the surah directly recounts the jinn hearing the Qur'an and submitting.

items.arabic: وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا ﴿١﴾ فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا ﴿٢﴾ فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا ﴿٣﴾ إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ ﴿٤﴾ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ ﴿٥﴾ إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ ﴿٦﴾ وَحِفْظًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَارِدٍ ﴿٧﴾ لَا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ ﴿٨﴾ دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ ﴿٩﴾ إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ ﴿١٠﴾
items.transliteration: Was-saffati saffa. Faz-zajirati zajra. Fat-taliyati dhikra. Inna ilahakum lawahid. Rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahuma wa Rabbul-mashariq. Inna zayyannas-sama'ad-dunya bizinatinil-kawakib. Wa hifzam-min kulli shaytanim-marid. La yassamma'una ilal-mala'il-a'la wa yuqdhafuna min kulli janib. Duhuraw-wa lahum 'adhabun wasib. Illa man khatifal-khatfata fa atba'ahu shihabun thaqib.
items.translation: By those angels lined up in ranks, and those who drive away, and those who recite the Reminder: Indeed, your God is One, Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, and Lord of the easts. Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars, and as protection against every rebellious devil. They cannot listen to the exalted assembly of angels, and they are pelted from every side, repelled — and for them is a constant punishment. Except one who snatches a fragment, and a piercing flame pursues him.
items.note: Describes the guarding of the heavens against rebellious devils; frequently recited in cases of jinn affliction.

items.arabic: لَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُتَصَدِّعًا مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ﴿٢١﴾ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ ۖ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ ﴿٢٢﴾ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ﴿٢٣﴾ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ﴿٢٤﴾
items.transliteration: Law anzalna hadhal-qur'ana 'ala jabalil-lara'aytahu khashi'am-mutasaddi'am-min khashyatillah. Wa tilkal-amthalu nadribuha linnasi la'allahum yatafakkarun. Huwal-lahul-ladhi la ilaha illa Huwa, 'Alimul-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Huwar-Rahmanur-Rahim. Huwal-lahul-ladhi la ilaha illa Huwal-Malikul-Quddusus-Salamul-Mu'minul-Muhayminul-'Azizul-Jabbarul-Mutakabbir. Subhanal-lahi 'amma yushrikun. Huwal-lahul-Khaliqul-Bari'ul-Musawwir, lahul-asma'ul-husna. Yusabbihu lahu ma fis-samawati wal-ard, wa Huwal-'Azizul-Hakim.
items.translation: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will reflect. He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity: the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. He is Allah: the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the Best Names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth glorifies Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
items.note: The closing of Surah Al-Hashr, magnifying Allah's names over the unseen — commonly recited three times in ruqyah.

items.arabic: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَنْ تَنْفُذُوا مِنْ أَقْطَارِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَانْفُذُوا ۚ لَا تَنْفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَانٍ ﴿٣٣﴾ فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ﴿٣٤﴾ يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِنْ نَارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنْتَصِرَانِ ﴿٣٥﴾ فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ﴿٣٦﴾
items.transliteration: Ya ma'sharal-jinni wal-insi inistata'tum an tanfudhu min aqtaris-samawati wal-ardi fanfudhu, la tanfudhuna illa bisultan. Fabi'ayyi ala'i Rabbikuma tukadhdhiban. Yursalu 'alaykuma shuwazum-min nariw-wa nuhasun fala tantasiran. Fabi'ayyi ala'i Rabbikuma tukadhdhiban.
items.translation: O assembly of jinn and mankind! If you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You cannot pass except by authority. So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny? There will be sent against you a flame of fire and molten copper, and you will not be able to defend yourselves. So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
items.note: A direct address to the assembly of jinn and men; recited as a warning and expulsion verse.

categories.title: Protection Adhkar (Before / After)
categories.subtitle: Daily adhkar and the du'a for the sick

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
items.note: Abu Dawud 5088, Tirmidhi 3388. Said three times morning and evening, nothing harms the one who says it.

items.arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.transliteration: Adhhibil-ba'sa Rabban-nas, ishfi wa Antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama.
items.translation: Remove the harm, O Lord of mankind. Heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing — a healing that leaves no illness behind.
items.note: Sahih al-Bukhari 5675, Sahih Muslim 2191. The Prophet ﷺ recited this over the sick while wiping over them with his right hand.

items.reference: Ruqyah of Jibril over the Prophet ﷺ
items.arabic: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنٍ حَاسِدٍ، اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi arqik, min kulli shay'in yu'dhik, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'aynin hasid, Allahu yashfik, bismillahi arqik.
items.translation: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah over you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul and every envious eye. May Allah heal you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah over you.
items.note: Sahih Muslim 2186. Jibril recited this ruqyah over the Prophet ﷺ.

items.reference: Ayat al-Kursi — Guardian of the Night
items.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum.
items.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.
items.note: Recite the full Ayat al-Kursi (see Common Ayats) before sleeping: a guardian from Allah remains over you and no devil approaches until morning (Sahih al-Bukhari 2311).
